per_line.source_text: .help-walkthrough,.help-guide{max-width:100%;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.help-lead{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 16px}.help-video-frame{margin:0 0 14px}.help-video-frame video{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:10px;background:#171009}.help-video-frame figcaption{margin-top:9px}.help-actions{display:grid;gap:12px;margin:16px 0}.help-transcript-link{text-align:center;color:var(--accent-text);font-size:14px;padding:8px}.help-transcript,.help-more{padding:12px 0;margin:15px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.help-transcript summary,.help-more summary{cursor:pointer;min-height:42px;font-weight:600}.help-transcript ol{padding-left:22px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}.help-steps{padding-left:22px;display:grid;gap:18px}.help-steps li{padding-left:2px}.help-steps h3,.help-dialed h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px}.help-steps p,.help-dialed p,.help-more p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;margin:0}.help-dialed{margin:20px 0;padding:15px;background:var(--well);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px}.help-support{margin:20px 0 0;font-size:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.help-support a{color:var(--accent-text)}@media(max-width:480px){.help-steps{padding-left:19px}.help-video-frame video{border-radius:6px}}
